context: A seminar where students share opinions with examples
purpose: Discuss ideas critically; teach 語る/挙げ/現れ/間違っ/許さ/それとも

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 今日は自分の経験を語る時間です。
lines.en: Today is a time to speak about your own experience.
lines.style: inviting teacher opening the discussion, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 具体例を挙げてもいいですか？
lines.en: May I give a concrete example?
lines.style: engaged student asking to contribute, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: もちろん。例を挙げて、自由に語る場です。
lines.en: Of course. This is a place to give examples and speak freely.
lines.style: encouraging teacher widening the floor, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 最近、街に新しい問題が現れています。
lines.en: Lately a new problem has appeared in town.
lines.style: observant student raising a real issue

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: それは興味深い。どこが間違っていると思う？
lines.en: That is interesting. Where do you think it goes wrong?
lines.style: probing teacher pushing for analysis, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 一部の主張が間違っているように見えます。
lines.en: Some of the claims seem mistaken.
lines.style: thoughtful student offering a critique, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 社会はそれを許さない雰囲気ですね。
lines.en: Society has an air that will not forgive it.
lines.style: analytical teacher noting the climate, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 賛成です。それとも別の見方がありますか？
lines.en: I agree. Or is there another view?
lines.style: open-minded student inviting alternatives, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 「それとも」と問い続ける姿勢が大事です。
lines.en: The habit of asking "or else?" matters.
lines.style: reflective teacher praising inquiry, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence
